question: Does a V2 plain section header keep scaled minimum44 when the trailing new-thread callback is absent?
answer: Yes. The shared header body constructs CodexTaskListRowMetrics before building the optional new-thread overlay, independently of header kind and callback presence.

evidence.fact: Projects constructor sets headerkind2 and zeroes trailing new-thread callback+40/context+48. It still instantiates the shared V2 header.

Loads header horizontalPadding+60. Constructs RowMetrics accessor3fa9b4 through45a6f0, sets horizontal padding, takes _minHeight field offset at metadata+14. Helper46398c writes Double44 (0x4046000000000000). Calls ScaledMetric.init(wrappedValue:) at3a1870.
Optional new-thread overlay is built afterwards. Its callback-nil branch is at3a1e20 and cannot skip prior RowMetrics construction.

RowMetrics body applies horizontal padding, reads ScaledMetric.wrappedValue at39fd38, uses it as minHeight via45dd58 ->44b2e0 ->457e94 frame assembly. Adds unscaled vertical2 padding at39fd9c ->460490 afterwards.
Header-specific extra topSpacing is applied outside RowMetrics and new-thread overlay.

minimum_reconstruction: Apply shared horizontal padding + frame(maxWidth:infinity,minHeight:scaled44) + vertical2 to the complete header base, regardless of whether the new-thread button exists. Overlay trailing button separately. Apply additional topSpacing0/10 outside. Match existing modifier order; avoid applying horizontal padding twice in the host.
